items.title: Improving language model behavior by training on a curated dataset
items.summary: Our latest research finds we can improve language model behavior with respect to specific behavioral values by fine-tuning on a small, curated dataset.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布研究成果，展示通过在精心挑选的小型数据集上进行微调，可以使语言模型在特定行为价值上表现得更好。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI的研究表明通过微调精选数据集可以有效改善语言模型行为。
